item.name: Market
item.description:
# market_api.php

**Endpoint:** `GET/POST {{baseUrl}}/mapi/market_api.php`

Market result API with IP whitelist (`user_domain` table).

---

## Authentication

| Param | Postman | Live server / website |
|-------|---------|------------------------|
| `domain_key` | Required | Required |
| `domain` | Optional | Optional (Referer verified if sent) |

**Postman:** `domain_key` + `market` — uses your public IP.

---

## Market list

`market_list=1` — all games from `market_name` (no `market` param needed).

Each row: `name`, `open_time`, `close_time`, `sat_day`, `sun_day`, `bg_yellow`

---

## Plan data access

| Plan (`package.month`) | Today | Previous date | `list=1` / history |
|------------------------|-------|---------------|---------------------|
| `0` trial / `1` monthly / `6` | Yes | No | No |
| `12` yearly | Yes | Yes | Yes (max 500) |

Error: `OLD Data not available for Monthly Plan`

---

## IP whitelist

• First call (IP empty): IP auto-saved
• IP matches: result returned
• IP mismatch: update IP from dashboard

---

## Examples

```
/mapi/market_api.php?market_list=1&domain_key=YOUR_KEY
/mapi/market_api.php?market=mainbazar&domain_key=YOUR_KEY
/mapi/market_api.php?market=mainbazar&domain=example.com&domain_key=YOUR_KEY
```

request.description: All markets from `market_name`: name, open/close time, sat_day, sun_day, bg_yellow.
Postman: no domain needed. Uses your public IP.
Previous date result — **12 month (yearly) plan only**.

item.name: Starline
item.description:
# starline_api.php

**Endpoint:** `GET/POST {{baseUrl}}/mapi/starline_api.php`

Starline (fatafat) API — same auth/plan rules as `market_api.php`.

**Tables:** `fatafat_game_list`, `fatafat_baji_list`, `fatafat_game_result`

---

## Authentication

| Param | Postman | Live server / website |
|-------|---------|------------------------|
| `domain_key` | Required | Required |
| `domain` | Optional | Required (or Referer/Origin) |

**Postman:** `domain_key` + `game` — uses your public IP.

---

## IP whitelist

• First call (IP empty): IP auto-saved
• IP matches: result returned
• IP mismatch: `Please update your IP from dashboard`

---

## Plan & request limit

• Active plan = `api_active_status` where **today** is between `f_from` and `t_to` (yearly plan preferred if multiple overlap)
• Each hit increments `total_req`; limit from `package.req` → `Your Request Limit Reached. Contact admin.`

---

## Plan data access (same as Market)

| Plan (`package.month`) | Today | Previous date | `list=1` / history |
|------------------------|-------|---------------|---------------------|
| `0` trial / `1` monthly / `6` | Yes | No | No |
| `12` yearly | Yes | Yes | Yes (max 500) |

Error: `OLD Data not available for Monthly Plan`

---

## Data source

• **Today:** live scrape first (`source: live`), fallback database (`source: database`)
• **Previous / history:** database only (yearly plan)

---

## Params

| Param | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `game_list=1` | All active games — no `game` needed |
| `game` | Game slug e.g. `kolkataff` (or `starline` param) |
| `baji_list=1` / `slots=1` | Slot list for one game |
| `baji` / `slot` | Single slot number |
| `date` | `YYYY-MM-DD` (**12 month plan only**) |
| `list=1` | History (`history`, `old`, `Rtype` also work) |
| `game=all` | All games for date |

---

## Examples

```
/mapi/starline_api.php?game_list=1&domain_key=YOUR_KEY
/mapi/starline_api.php?game=kolkataff&domain_key=YOUR_KEY
/mapi/starline_api.php?game=kolkataff&baji=1&domain_key=YOUR_KEY
/mapi/starline_api.php?game=kolkataff&date=2026-06-10&domain_key=YOUR_KEY
/mapi/starline_api.php?game=kolkataff&list=1&domain_key=YOUR_KEY
/mapi/starline_api.php?game=all&domain_key=YOUR_KEY
```

request.description: Slots / baji times for one game from `fatafat_baji_list`.
All slots with today's results for one game.
All games with results for today.

item.name: Satta
item.description:
# satta_api.php

**Delhi Side Satta Live Result**

**Endpoint:** `GET/POST {{baseUrl}}/mapi/satta_api.php`

**Tables:** `satta_list`, `satta_result`

Same auth/plan logic as `market_api.php`.

---

## Authentication

| Param | Postman | Live server |
|-------|---------|-------------|
| `domain_key` | Required | Required |
| `domain` | Optional | Optional (Referer verified if sent) |

**Postman:** `domain_key` + `game` — uses your public IP.

---

## IP whitelist

• First call (IP empty): IP auto-saved
• IP matches: result returned
• IP mismatch: `Please update your IP from dashboard`

---

## Plan & request limit

• Active plan = today between `f_from` and `t_to` (yearly `12` preferred if multiple overlap)
• Each hit increments `total_req`; limit from `package.req`
• Limit reached: `Your Request Limit Reached. Contact admin.`

---

## Plan data access

| Plan (`package.month`) | Today | Previous date | `list=1` / history |
|------------------------|-------|---------------|---------------------|
| `0` trial / `1` monthly / `6` | Yes | No | No |
| `12` yearly | Yes | Yes | Yes (max 500) |

Error: `OLD Data not available for Monthly Plan`

---

## Params

| Param | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `satta_list=1` | Game list (`name`, `time`, `bg_yellow`) |
| `game` / `satta` | Game name e.g. `GALI` |
| `date` | `YYYY-MM-DD` (**12 month plan only**) |
| `list=1` | Full history |
| `game=all` | All games for date |

---

## Examples

```
/mapi/satta_api.php?satta_list=1&domain_key=YOUR_KEY
/mapi/satta_api.php?game=GALI&domain_key=YOUR_KEY
/mapi/satta_api.php?game=GALI&date=2026-06-10&domain_key=YOUR_KEY
/mapi/satta_api.php?game=GALI&list=1&domain_key=YOUR_KEY
/mapi/satta_api.php?game=all&domain_key=YOUR_KEY
```

request.description: All games from `satta_list`: name, time, bg_yellow.

item.name: Teer API
item.description:
# teer_api.php

**Teer Live Result**

**Endpoint:** `GET/POST {{baseUrl}}/mapi/teer_api.php`

**Tables:** `teer_game`, `teer_result`

Same auth/plan logic as other MAPI endpoints (`mapi_shared.php`).

---

## Authentication

| Param | Postman | Live server |
|-------|---------|-------------|
| `domain_key` | Required | Required (`user_domain.unique_key`) |
| `domain` | Optional | Optional (Referer verified if sent) |

---

## Plan data access

| Plan (`package.month`) | Today | Previous date | `list=1` / history |
|------------------------|-------|---------------|---------------------|
| `0` trial / `1` monthly / `6` | Yes | No | No |
| `12` yearly | Yes | Yes | Yes (max 500) |

Error: `OLD Data not available for Monthly Plan`

---

## Params

| Param | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `game_list=1` / `teer_list=1` | All games from `teer_game` (`name`, `fr_time`, `sr_time`) |
| `game` / `teer` | Game name e.g. `Shillong Teer` |
| `date` | `YYYY-MM-DD` (**12 month plan only**) |
| `list=1` | Full history per game (`date` as `DD-MM-YYYY` in each row) |
| `game=all` | All games for date |

---

## Result row (today / single date)

`name`, `fr_result`, `sr_result`, `fr_time`, `sr_time`

## History row (`list=1`)

`name`, `fr_result`, `sr_result`, `date` (e.g. `11-06-2026`)

---

## Examples

```
/mapi/teer_api.php?game_list=1&domain_key=YOUR_KEY
/mapi/teer_api.php?game=Shillong Teer&domain_key=YOUR_KEY
/mapi/teer_api.php?game=Shillong Teer&date=2026-06-10&domain_key=YOUR_KEY
/mapi/teer_api.php?game=Shillong Teer&list=1&domain_key=YOUR_KEY
/mapi/teer_api.php?game=all&domain_key=YOUR_KEY
```

request.description: All games from `teer_game`: name, fr_time, sr_time.
Today's FR/SR result for one game.
Full history (max 500) — date per row as DD-MM-YYYY — **12 month plan only**.
All teer games with today's results.
